entries.title: A three-dimensional Riesz pair has negative transverse curvature
entries.statement: For s>0 and x in R^3 minus {0}, V_s(x)=|x|^{-s} has Hessian s|x|^{-s-2}[(s+2)ee^T-I], where e=x/|x|. Its radial eigenvalue is s(s+1)|x|^{-s-2}, and each of its two transverse eigenvalues is -s|x|^{-s-2}. Thus convexity of r to r^{-s} on (0,infinity) does not give convexity in vector displacements.
entries.proof_text: Differentiate grad V_s(x)=-s|x|^{-s-2}x. The displayed Hessian follows. Acting on e gives s(s+1)|x|^{-s-2}e; acting on any v perpendicular to e gives -s|x|^{-s-2}v. Equivalently, V_s((1,t,0))=(1+t^2)^{-s/2} has second derivative -s at t=0.
assumptions: x is a nonzero vector in R^3
This is a pair-potential statement and makes no assertion about the full Hessian

entries.title: Bragg lower bound for a globally convex labeled displacement Gibbs model
entries.statement: Let D be a finite nonempty subset of Z^3 and L_D the Dirichlet nearest-neighbor lattice Laplacian on D (diagonal 6, off-diagonal -1 for neighbors). Let H_D:R^{3|D|}->R be C^2 and even, with D^2H_D(u) >= kappa(L_D tensor I_3) for every u and kappa>0. At beta>0 let P_D(du) be proportional to exp(-beta H_D(u))du. For nonzero G in 2pi Z^3 set B_{D,G}=|D|^{-1} sum_{x in D} exp(i G dot (x+u_x)) and C_3=(2pi)^{-3} integral_{[-pi,pi]^3} [2 sum_j(1-cos q_j)]^{-1}dq. Then C_3<infinity and Re E B_{D,G} >= 1-|G|^2 C_3/(2 beta kappa). If a=1-|G|^2 C_3/(2 beta kappa)>0, then E|B_{D,G}|^2>=a^2.
entries.proof_text: The global Hessian lower bound makes P_D integrable and L_D positive definite. Apply the Brascamp-Lieb covariance inequality to V=beta H_D with Gamma=beta kappa(L_D tensor I_3): Var(G dot u_x) <= |G|^2 (L_D^{-1})_{xx}/(beta kappa). The killed-walk Green representation bounds (L_D^{-1})_{xx} by the unrestricted lattice Green value C_3, whose Fourier integrand behaves as |q|^{-2} near zero and is integrable in dimension three. Evenness gives E u_x=0. Since G dot x is a multiple of 2pi and cos t>=1-t^2/2, averaging the cosine bound gives Re E B_{D,G} >= a. Jensen gives E|B_{D,G}|^2>=|E B_{D,G}|^2>=a^2 when a>0.
assumptions: D finite and nonempty subset of Z^3 with Dirichlet boundary
H_D globally C^2 and even on all R^{3|D|}
uniform all-displacement Hessian lower bound with kappa>0
This labeled model is not asserted to be a continuum Riesz Gibbs measure

relations.rationale: The source theorem assumes a global positive-definite Hessian lower bound and concludes a covariance upper bound. The conditional lemma uses it with V=beta H_D and Gamma=beta kappa(L_D tensor I_3).
P0309 concerns 3D Riesz Gibbs phases. Negative transverse pair curvature blocks an automatic termwise convexity argument; it is not evidence that the phase does not exist.
